long_biography.plain_text:
Remote controls gave Lauro Buoro a way to distinguish early home-automation products through design as well as electronics. Nice began with transmitters for gates and garage doors, then developed integrated systems for access, security and connected buildings. After a stock-market listing broadened its capital base, his holding company remained Nice's primary shareholder through its later international expansion.

Buoro has used BeNice Holding to widen that industrial platform into Italian design. Its majority acquisition of Valcucine added high-end kitchens to a portfolio shaped around technology, function and the built environment. As BeNice's president and chief executive, he directs a holding company that combines manufacturing, product development and investment.
